note: Fishing resort at the end of Twin Lakes Road at Upper Twin Lake, 7,100 ft, with a marina, boat rentals, cafe and store. The campground sits under tall pines behind the marina; hookup and dry sites, first-come only. Arrivals after the gate closes pick an open site and register before 9 a.m. Closed in winter. --Claude
summary: Annett's Mono Village: private FCFS resort campground, $35 dry / $45 hookup (W/S/E) for 2 + tax, under the US$50 gate; monthly rates offered. Google 4.3 (545). Lakeview -> not waterfront recommended (continuous pine canopy, lake 100-200 m away behind the marina and its lot). Season not published. Phone and website confirmed.
flags: WATERFRONT: stored 'lakeview' (not --AWH) -> recommend 'not waterfront'. The campground is under continuous pine canopy west of the marina; the nearest trailers are 100-200 m from the lake across the marina parking lot and docks (a developed buffer). The operator's only campground photo shows pine forest with no water. No source shows a lake view from any site. Robinson Creek and its willow-lined inlet run along the campground's south edge (around 38.1450,-119.3790 to 38.1455,-119.3765), and a few pads on imagery look close to it. The park publishes no site numbers, so creekside cannot be earned; flagged for the reviewer only.

LONG-STAY: the camp-sites page lists monthly rates ($625 dry / $850 hookup) and a 'Seasonal' pet rate, so monthly and seasonal stays are sold. Nightly share is NOT measurable: there is no booking engine (all first-come) and no site map. The page leads with nightly rates, has no minimum stay and no wording discouraging nightly guests, and the resort is a 300-space fishing campground. Not 'mostly seasonal' on the evidence read; reviewer's call.
PRICE GATE: $45 hookup for 2 before tax -> under US$50, passes with no exception needed. Extra people are $3 each.
SEASON: no opening or closing dates on any operator page read (home, camp-sites, news, cabins, storage). Stored year_round false kept (derived); trailer storage runs to 'Mid-April'.
HOOKUPS: amperage not published - electric left unset (water and sewer written).
SITES: the home page says '300 space campground', the camp-sites page says 'Over 250 sites' - wrote 300.
OHV: 'All 1, 2, 3, & 4 wheel recreational vehicles are prohibited for personal use within Mono Village' - not an OHV park.
PHONE 760-932-7071 and WEBSITE https://monovillage.com/ confirmed (Google listing matches).
